principle: Parsing success, structural fidelity, recovery coverage, solver acceptance, and solution correctness are SEPARATE metrics. None implies the next.

structural_fidelity.means: typed canonical_tree persisted in the recovery record

recovery_coverage.means: every source occurrence has a recovery record

solver_acceptance.means: SymPy accepted the recovered expression -- NOT correctness

solution_correctness.means: Requires independent validation (substitution back into the source relation, dimension check, or symbolic equivalence). Solver acceptance is NOT evidence.

population_b_e2e_single_paper.note: This is a DIFFERENT population from the 4235-occurrence structural pipeline. Do not compare denominators.

population_boundary: Population A (4235 occurrences, 14 papers) and Population B (991 equations, paper 2605.00155) are different populations. Their denominators are not comparable.
